reasons: Section 18.1-18.2 matches the preferred position in full: CGL USD 1M/2M, E&O USD 2M, cyber/privacy USD 5M, workers' compensation as required by law, at Vendor's expense for the term plus one year, with certificates on request.
Compliant status correctly carries no redline and no counterparty comment; deterministic check confirms an insurance obligation is present.
Rationale accurately cites the clause text and identifies the extra protections (reputable insurers, primary coverage, cancellation notice, insurance does not limit liability) without over-flagging.
